facts.value: The study of law is an enriching educational experience that provides intellectual stimulation and exposure to decision-making and argumentative skills. The LLB in Common and Civil Law programme provides an opportunity to obtain a bachelor’s degree in both Common Law (The Irish/UK legal system) and Civil Law (the system used in most mainland European jurisdictions). Graduates can therefore expect to have a wide variety of options open to them upon graduation.
University of Limerick moot court and appellate court facilities.
Students graduate equipped to deal with working in the legal environments in Ireland and France.
UL’s School of Law was awarded Law School of the Year at the prestigious LEAP Irish Law Awards 2025.
Students can experience living and studying in the picturesque city of Besancon.
The Bachelor of Laws in Common and Civil Law covers the core subjects required for the Law Society of Ireland Final Examination, Part 1.
The programme is an approved degree for the purpose of Rule 4 of the Education Rules of the Honorable Society of Kings Inns.
Please contact the School of Law, University of Limerick, for current information about exemptions.
